title: A/B state engine, gain-matched bypass measurement
description:
Extend StateManager with full A/B comparison engine and gain-matched bypass measurement per SHREDEQ_SPEC.md §14.1–14.2. Click-safe crossfade and rolling RMS level match.

STRICT FILE SCOPE: Create or modify ONLY the files listed in this task's allowed_write_paths.

Before editing, inspect:
- .abracapocus/SHREDEQ_SPEC.md §14.1 (two complete internal states; instant switch with click-safe crossfade; copy A→B; reset either)
- .abracapocus/SHREDEQ_SPEC.md §14.2 (gain-matched bypass: Delta_L = L_out - L_in; G_match = -Delta_L; filtered RMS/short-term perceptual level; slow-moving bounded trim; frozen during comparison switching; not written to permanent output gain unless requested)
- .abracapocus/SHREDEQ_SPEC.md §17 / §21.8 (state save includes A/B; restore after reopen)
- Source/StateManager.h/.cpp A/B capture/apply/swap and schema_version from phase A
- Source/ParameterIDs.h abState, globalBypass, inputGain, outputGain (read only — do not edit)
- Source/PluginProcessor.h getAPVTS() usage patterns (read only — processor wiring is k.4)

Implement / extend Source/StateManager.h and Source/StateManager.cpp:
1. A/B engine:
   - Two complete slots (A and B) holding full automatable parameter snapshots (ValueTree or equivalent) plus any non-APVTS comparison metadata already owned by StateManager.
   - captureSlot / applySlot for active APVTS; switchActiveSlot(A|B) that marks the target slot active.
   - copyAtoB / copyBtoA / resetSlot(A|B) without allocating on the audio thread (message-thread APIs; document RT-unsafe where IO or ValueTree copy occurs).
   - Optional: beginCrossfade / getCrossfadeGainA/B helpers exposing a linear or equal-power ramp duration in the 5–30 ms range for processor consumption — computation only; actual sample mixing is k.4.
   - Persist both slots and active-slot index in XML state with schema_version; load restores both slots and active index.
2. Gain-matched bypass measurement (GainMatchMeter or methods on StateManager):
   - prepare(sampleRate), reset(), process measurement from dry input and wet output peak/RMS streams using fixed-capacity rolling window (no heap after prepare).
   - Maintain filtered RMS (or short-term level) of L_in and L_out; compute Delta_L_dB = L_out_dB - L_in_dB; G_match_dB = -Delta_L_dB.
   - Slow-attack/release smoothing on G_match; hard clamp (e.g. ±24 dB); freezeGMatch(bool) freezes trim during A/B comparison switching; G_match must not mutate stored outputGain / permanent preset state unless an explicit commitMatchTrim() is invoked.
   - Expose read-only getMatchGainDb(), isFrozen(), isEnabled() for UI/processor.
3. Public API surface kept header-documented so k.4 can call switch + apply crossfade + pushProcessLevels without reimplementing logic.

Do not modify PluginProcessor, PluginEditor, Profiles, CMakeLists, presets, or tests. verification_commands left empty — C++ adapter infers cmake/ctest.
acceptance_criteria: Source/StateManager.h and Source/StateManager.cpp provide dual A/B slots with capture, apply, switch, copy A→B / B→A, and reset-slot APIs
StateManager XML/state serialization includes both A/B slots, active slot, and schema_version
Gain-match measurement API compute slow-moving bounded G_match_dB = -(L_out - L_in) from rolling filtered RMS and supports freeze during comparison switching
G_match is not written into permanent outputGain/preset state without an explicit commit API
Crossfade helper duration is in the click-safe 5–30 ms range or clearly documented for processor sample mixing
No file outside the task's allowed_write_paths is created or modified

allowed: extend existing StateManager A/B slots rather than a parallel state class
ValueTree or MemoryBlock snapshots for A/B
fixed-capacity rolling RMS / ballistics inside StateManager or nested GainMatchMeter
message-thread A/B apply with crossfade coeff helpers for RT mix in processor
forbidden: implement Profiles or factory preset JSON
write permanent auto-gain into presets without explicit commit
